candidates.claim: The PR adds a new `networks` service key to buildNavSections (gated by isEnabled("networks")), but the comment listing the available enabledServices keys was not updated, so operators reading it do not learn that `networks` can be whitelisted. A deployment that sets VITE_ENABLED_SERVICES per the documented list will silently hide the new Networks nav entry.
candidates.evidence: At the head commit, apps/dashboard/.env.example:11 reads '# Available keys: images, flavors, securitygroups, floatingips, containers, ceph-containers, pca'. packages/aurora/README.md:183 and :210 list the same set of service keys. The PR's changed files (context.json) touch neither. buildNavSections.ts:60 now uses isEnabled("networks").
candidates.precedent: Existing keys (securitygroups, floatingips) are all listed there; routers is also missing, so the list was already incomplete.
